neighbours.label: an auxiliary or modal verb ('may', 'could', 'would', 'have been') in the middle of a clause
fire: The two remaining seats may be filled by any local resident.
Researchers have been surprised by how quickly the ice melted.
About a third of the players would pass the ball rather than shoot.
Visitors could see the comet clearly from the hilltop.
The other applicants may apply again next year.
Volunteers have been extremely helpful during the flood.
Most residents would prefer a park to a parking lot.
The leftover funds could be spent on new books.
quiet: The two remaining seats went to local residents last spring.
Researchers watched the ice melt during the warm week.
About a third of the players passed the ball rather than shooting.
Visitors saw the comet clearly from the hilltop.
The other applicants apply again every year.
Volunteers worked very hard during the flood.
Most residents want a park instead of a parking lot.
The leftover funds went to new books for the school.

notes: card: ' may' x4, ' been', ' could', ' would', ' are'; weak (max 13.75); - pole is 'is used' passives
